name: Hector Pieterson Memorial and Museum
description: Honours the students of the 16 June 1976 uprising. The museum tells the story of the day through photographs, film and first-hand accounts.

name: Mandela House, Vilakazi Street
description: The house Nelson Mandela lived in from 1946, on the only street in the world that was home to two Nobel Peace Prize winners.

name: Orlando Towers
description: The painted cooling towers of the old Orlando power station, now a landmark for bungee jumping, murals and views over Soweto.

name: Walter Sisulu Square of Dedication
description: Where the Freedom Charter was adopted in 1955. The square hosts a monument, a museum and markets.

name: Regina Mundi Church
description: Soweto's largest Catholic church and a refuge for students in 1976. Bullet marks from that time are still visible inside.

name: Kliptown Open Air Museum
description: An outdoor walk through the history of the Freedom Charter and the Congress of the People.
